gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients newly diagnosed with primary glioblastoma by imaging or pathology, completed concurrent chemoradiotherapy (CCRT), and planned to receive adjuvant TMZ treatment;

candidate_evidence.quote: A Phase II clinical study is planned to evaluate the efficacy and safety of fluzoparib combined with temozolomide in newly diagnosed glioblastoma patients after completing standard concurrent chemoradiotherapy (CCRT)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients newly diagnosed with primary glioblastoma by imaging or pathology, completed concurrent chemoradiotherapy (CCRT), and planned to receive adjuvant TMZ treatment;

role_evidence.quote: Fluzoparib: 100mg, po.bid. Q4W, d1-28, for a total of 6 cycles
Temozolomide (TMZ): 150-200 mg/m2, po. Q4W, d1-5, for a total of 6 cycles
The TMZ dose is adjusted by the investigator according to standard chemotherapy requirements.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care (adjuvant)

coder_notes: Title spells 'Flazoparib'; interventions and summary use 'Fluzoparib' (moiety fluzoparib). Single-arm phase 2: fluzoparib added to standard adjuvant TMZ after CCRT in newly diagnosed GBM. No biomarker selection.
